notes.title: We are fixing the audio bug
notes.notes:
[p][b]We have heard reports that there is static overriding the audio.[/b]

This is being investigated, and a fix for PC will be up within the next four hours.  Mac & Linux versions will follow Monday AM.

[b]We apologize for this oversight - rest assured that[/b] [b]fixing this is our #1 priority![/b][/p]

notes.title: The First Beta
notes.notes:
[i][b]HEY, EVERYONE! [/b][/i] We apologize for being away for so danged long - but you have to remember that we are a [i]very [/i]small team trying to cover a [i]LOT [/i]of bases.  I literally work 11 hours a day, 7 days a week, and sometimes, things fall through the cracks!

[b]First off: we are VERY [i]VERY [/i]CLOSE to Beta![/b]  It will be buggy, and not all content is there, but it is something we look forward to presenting to ya'll and possible publishers.

Currently, we're just about 5-6 bugs/features short of this goal- and we plan on meeting it on May 3 [i](we initially planned on May 1, but I came down with a bout of insmonia that has now deprived me of sleep for over 56 hours!)[/i]

[b]TO GET ACCESS:  People who have contributed $25 or more to [url=https://patreon.com/peaceisland]our Patreon [/url]are entitled to either: [/b]

1: an Early Access key that will grant immediate access, or
2: a key to unlock Peace Island upon release.

[b]WHAT'S IN THE BETA:[/b]

The Beta preview of Peace Island currently contains more content than most Indie games have in their entirety!

- 75% of the island is explorable - everything but Greenwood Farms, and Catnip Ledge.
- Ten interiors - homes, businesses, and public buildings.
- Seven NPC species - Deer, Bees, Crow, Seagulls, Beaver, Chicken, and Geese!
- Over 700 pages of original content - from casual notes to [i]entire books.[/i]
- Over an hour of Original Audio, including a 40-minute radio broadcast.
- Fifteen minutes of original video
- Over fifty mission starts (although not all are currently completable.)

[i]BTW - if you are wondering: we plan on including over 2,000 pages of OC, two hours of audio, and more than an hour of video/cutscene in the full game! [/i]

Thanks so much for following and favoriting Peace Island!  Follow our progress on [url=https://patreon.com/peaceisland]our Patreon [/url] - 90% of posts/updates are public!
